name: consensum-migrator
description: Minimal Prisma CLI install used ONLY to run `prisma migrate deploy` at container start. The application runtime is the self-contained Next.js standalone build; this isolated tree keeps the heavy prisma-CLI dependencies (Studio, the pglite dev DB, mysql/postgres drivers) and all devDependencies out of the shipped image. Versions are pinned to match the root package.json / pnpm-lock.yaml.
comment:overrides: This tree is installed with npm, outside the pnpm workspace, so the overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml do NOT reach it — fixable CVEs here need a second entry below or the Trivy image gate stays red. find-my-way arrives via prisma -> @prisma/dev, which pins it exactly (9.6.0 = CVE-2026-47219, HTTP/2 DoS). Kept as a range, not a pin, so a later prisma bump can float it up instead of us silently downgrading its transitive dep.
